typography.instructions: Replace 'Fraunces' and 'Inter' with 'Fredoka' (Headings) and 'Nunito' (Body). Add Google Fonts import: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Nunito:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,500&display=swap');. These fonts are friendly, highly legible, and eliminate the 'formal/corporate' look while remaining highly professional for EdTech.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use chunky 3D-style bottom borders/shadows for buttons instead of standard drop shadows (e.g., border-bottom-width: 4px). Use soft ambient shadows for static cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 2px solid borders (border-slate-200) around cards, nodes, and game panels to define boundaries clearly.
visual_enhancers.radii: Use maximum rounding: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons.

component_guidelines.buttons: Implement the 'EdTech Bounce' button style: background-color: var(--primary); color: white; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--primary-dark); border-bottom-width: 4px; transition: transform 0.1s, border-width 0.1s. On active: transform: translateY(2px); border-bottom-width: 2px.
component_guidelines.map_cards: Level nodes should be flex rows, rounded-3xl, white background, 2px border-slate-200. Left side: real photo thumbnail (rounded-2xl). Right side: Bilingual Title (EN bold, ES smaller/muted), stars, and a chunky Play button.
component_guidelines.certificate: A4 Landscape format. REMOVE 'SENA' completely. Add 'English Kids' (text only) as the issuing entity using Fredoka font. Use a clean white background with gold (#FACC15) corner accents (e.g., using absolute positioned divs with 4px border on two sides). Include lines for 'Teacher' and 'Director' signatures, and a gold seal badge.
component_guidelines.game_header: Header should feature a real photo thumbnail, the bilingual title, and a score progress bar with a bright yellow fill.
component_guidelines.bilingual_text: EN text must be the primary focus (e.g., text-lg, font-bold, text-slate-800). ES text must act as a support subtitle directly below (e.g., text-sm, font-medium, text-slate-500).

layouts.landing: Keep the editorial/dossier sections but use wavy dividers or soft background color blocks to separate sections. Maintain a max-width for readability.
layouts.level_map: Vertical scrolling path with dashed SVG or CSS line connecting the level cards.
layouts.game_screens: Centered, single-column max-w-3xl. White game boards floating on a soft slate-50 background.

motion.cards: Hover states should lift the card slightly (-translate-y-1) and change border color to primary.
motion.feedback: Use a gentle shake animation for wrong answers and a pop/scale animation for correct ones.

accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure white text on light buttons (like yellow) has sufficient contrast; use text-slate-900 on yellow buttons.
accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive buttons and cards to accommodate young children's motor skills.

image_urls.instructions: Use these specific real photo URLs for the thumbnails and hero images in each level to meet the user's request for real image bank photos.

instructions_to_main_agent: In App.css, replace the Fraunces and Inter fonts with Fredoka and Nunito.
Completely overwrite the App.css root CSS variables to use the new Vibrant Play palette (Primary Sky Blue, Secondary Yellow, Slate Text). Remove the dark pine and muted gold.
Refactor ALL .btn classes in App.css to have the 'chunky 3D' border-bottom effect instead of standard box-shadows.
In the Certificate component, completely remove the 'SENA' text and branding. Change the main heading to 'English Kids' using text-only. Add gold corner borders to the .cert-sheet.
Ensure every single bilingual text instance in the games and level map displays English as primary (large, bold, dark) and Spanish underneath (smaller, lighter color, perhaps medium weight).
Update the Map Node cards (.map-node) to use rounded-3xl, thick 2px borders, and place the real photo thumbnails from the image_urls list.

Expand the game content: The user specifically requested longer games. You MUST expand the data arrays/logic for each level to include more questions/pairs (e.g., 6-8 color questions, larger memory grid or multiple rounds, more matching pairs) so the gameplay isn't too short.
Keep core React state mechanisms working, but feel free to expand the state data to support longer game rounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties only.
Create depth through layered design elements and bottom borders.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
Prioritize generous padding and large border radii for a kid-friendly tactile feel.
